thread:
Nina (Design): Quick design thread: reworking the audit log navigation inside Org Settings. Problem: admins can't quickly jump from an audit entry (e.g., invite.created) to the role definition or org-level SSO page. Mock: https://redwood.design/s/audit-jump.png :mag_right:

Omar (Frontend): Love the idea. Two minor engineering notes: 1) add anchor links to roles (/orgs/:id/roles#role-xyz) rather than deep-copying UI state, 2) ensure the jump preserves scroll position and focuses the role header. I can implement scrollIntoView + focus() on the header element.

Priya (PM): Product asks: when an audit entry references SSO changes, show a small contextual CTA 'View SSO settings' next to the log item. Don't auto-navigate; let users confirm. Also, update copy for invite entries: change 'invited user' to 'invited account' to be consistent with our glossary.

Sam (A11y): Accessibility: the jump needs an announcement so screen-reader users know they moved contexts. Use aria-live="polite" and announce something like: 'Navigated to Roles, role: Billing, highlighted'. Also, ensure the anchor has tabindex="-1" before focusing so focus is programmatic.

Nina (Design): For visual affordance, I'll add a subtle highlight animation on the target role for 2s and a persistent outline until user interacts. For SSO CTAs, the label will be 'View SSO settings' and helper tooltip will be a keyboard-accessible info button that opens a dialog.

Omar (Frontend): Implementation plan: add data-role-id to elements, expose a route with #role-<id>. On hashchange, find element and run element.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth', block:'center'}); set tabindex='-1' and element.focus(); then announce via a live region. Will add tests.

Priya (PM): Also add analytics: audit_viewed_jump, audit_jump_target. We want counts of how often people jump from logs to role pages vs copy the role name manually.

Sam (A11y): Small nit: don't rely on color to show highlight; also provide an aria-describedby on the role header that reads the audit context (e.g., 'Changed by: alice@company.com at 2026-03-10'). That helps when the page is long.

Deploy Bot: preview:audit-jump built  https://staging.redwood/preview/audit-jump (sha: zxy987) :white_check_mark:

Omar (Frontend): Ran quick axe: flagged missing aria-live region and the highlight animation had reduced-motion issues. I'll add prefers-reduced-motion support and create the live region element.

Nina (Design): I'll update Figma to include reduced-motion variant and provide the exact copy for the SSO CTA and the role microcopy.

Priya (PM): Timeline: target merge this sprint if a11y checks pass. If Sam finds issues, we'll delay. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
